title: 第十一章 一朝为奴被犬欺第十二章 若为修为故一切皆可抛
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 玄稷见仙女姐姐跟荷花他们一样怕辣椒，赶忙把辣椒收进空间里。
“仙女姐姐你没事吧？”
“那是你种出来的？”
玄稷点头。
“尊上，小公主她种出来的东西太恐怖了。”
慕狱心有余悸。
他跟着尊上后，得知尊上之前给自己吃那绿色极品灵植，是小公主种出来的，还一度怀疑。
直到亲眼所见。
也明白尊上为什么会带着她了。
见小公主又要种地的时候直接全程紧跟。
就是希望小公主高兴能给自己一点两点的，省得他想方设法从尊上那求赏了。
结果这辣椒刚种出来时，他差点没被熏得原地去世。
那哪是什么能提升修为的极品灵植？
那辣椒散发出来的精纯阳罡气，简直就是魔修的克星！
他怀疑这小公主是故意的，但没证据。
范沐禾懒得理慕狱，看着玄稷。
“那你种点别的吧。”
她也不去修炼了，跟在玄稷身旁看她种。
她收的那一小片狗尾巴草，一共也就二十几株，昨天修炼了一整天，又耗费了五株，再这么下去很快就能吃完了。
玄稷高兴地点头。
拿出一个装种子的布袋子。
这些种子都是荷花莲花找来给她的。
她长那么大就没吃过什么正经的东西，所以对那些种子基本也都不认识。
辣椒也是荷花和莲花教她辨认的才知道。
这会也不问他们了，随便抓了一颗种子出来种上。
荷花和莲花都有心里阴影了，都站到玄稷身后去了。
几人正全神贯注地等看玄稷这次种出来的是什么，没人发现一旁不对劲的大胖。
大胖在小主人种出辣椒的第一时间，以为这个辣椒一定跟狗尾巴草一样好吃就啃了一口。
大胖吃东西向来是到狗嘴也就到了狗肚子里。
结果那叫一个辣。
要不是浑身狗毛覆盖，肯定能发现现在的大胖是个通红的狗。
大胖被辣得团团转，喝了好几口小主人浇花的水都没用。
“大胖，这个不能喝，这是小公主浇菜用的水，我去给你拿能喝的。”
莲花发现了大胖的异状，摸了摸狗头去给拿水了。
荷花直接把大胖搂住了，开始给它顺毛挠痒痒。
荷花莲花停下来没事干，大胖就会让她们给自己撸毛挠痒。
两人也极为喜欢撸狗。
“大胖，你怎么那么暖。”
content_en:
Xuanji saw that the fairy sister was as afraid of peppers as Hehua and the others, so he quickly put the peppers into the space.
"Sister Fairy, are you okay?"
"Did you grow that?"
Xuan Ji nodded.
"Your Majesty, what the little princess has grown is too terrifying."
Mu Yu was still frightened.
After he followed His Majesty, he learned that the green top-grade spiritual plant that His Majesty gave him to eat was grown by the little princess, and he was doubtful for a while.
Until you see it with your own eyes.
I also understand why Your Majesty took her with me.
When I saw the little princess going to farm again, I followed her closely throughout the process.
I just hope that the little princess will be happy to give him a little or two, so that he will not have to find ways to ask for rewards from his Majesty.
As a result, when the pepper was first planted, he almost died from the smoke.
So where is the best spiritual plant that can improve cultivation?
The pure yang energy emitted by the pepper is simply the nemesis of demon cultivators!
He suspected that the little princess did it on purpose, but there was no evidence.
Fan Muhe was too lazy to pay attention to Mu Yu and looked at Xuan Ji.
"Then you plant something else."
She stopped practicing and followed Xuan Ji to watch her harvest.
The small piece of dogtail grass she collected was only about twenty plants in total. She practiced all day yesterday and spent five more plants. If she continues like this, she will finish them all soon.
Xuan Ji nodded happily.
Take out a cloth bag containing seeds.
These seeds were brought to her by Lotus Lotus.
She has never eaten anything serious since she was so old, so she basically doesn't know those seeds.
She only learned about peppers after lotus and lotus flowers taught her how to identify them.
I didn’t ask them any questions now, I just grabbed a seed and planted it.
Lotus and Lotus both felt shadowed in their hearts and stood behind Xuan Ji.
Several people were waiting intently to see what Xuan Ji would grow this time, and no one noticed that something was wrong with the big fat man on the side.
When the little master planted the chili pepper, Big Fatty thought it must be as delicious as foxtail grass and took a bite.
Big fat food always goes to the dog's mouth and then into the dog's belly.
It turned out to be spicy.
If it weren't for the fact that he was covered in dog hair, he would definitely have noticed that the big fat dog was now a red dog.
The big fat man was so hot that he drank several mouthfuls of water from the little master to water the flowers, but it was no use.
"Big Fatty, you can't drink this. This is the water the little princess uses to water vegetables. I'll get you something you can drink."
Lianhua noticed something strange about Big Fatty, touched the dog's head and went to get some water.
Lotus directly hugged Big Fatty and began to tickle him.
When Lotus Lotus stopped and had nothing to do, Big Fatty would ask them to stroke their hair and scratch their itch.
The two also like playing with dogs very much.
"Big Fatty, why are you so warm?"
title_en: Chapter 11: Once a Slave and Bullied by a Dog Chapter 12: If You Cultivate Yourself, Everything Can Be Thrown Away
